a web framework for R

Build for the web, with R.

Ambiorix is an unopinionated, minimalist web framework inspired by express.js. Routing, middleware, templating, websockets and async — one syntax, all in R.

library(ambiorix)

app <- Ambiorix$new(port = 3000L)

app$get("/", function(req, res) {
  res$send("Hello, World!")
})

app$start()

Install

Up and running in two commands.

The stable release is on CRAN. The development version lives on GitHub.

1 — install the package

install.packages("ambiorix")

2 — run your app

Rscript app.R

Features

Everything you need to serve R over HTTP.

Nothing here is mandatory. Use the pieces you need and ignore the rest.

Routing

Build multipage applications right out of the box.

Templating

For server-side rendering. HTML, markdown, pug, and more.

Middleware

Easily pre-process every request to the server.

Websockets

For when you need bi-directional communication between server and client.

Async

Use asynchronous programming by returning promises from request handlers.

Autonomy

You have absolute, full control over the request-response cycle.

In practice

A whole app, in one file.

Middleware, static files, path parameters and a JSON endpoint — under thirty lines.

library(ambiorix)

app <- Ambiorix$new(port = 3000L)

# middleware runs on every request
app$use(function(req, res) {
  req$received_at <- Sys.time()
})

# serves index.html from the same directory
app$get("/", function(req, res) {
  res$send_file("index.html")
})

# path parameters
app$get("/users/:id", function(req, res) {
  res$json(list(id = req$params$id))
})

# POST with a JSON body
app$post("/users", function(req, res) {
  body <- parse_json(req)
  res$json(list(created = body))
})

app$start()

Going further

Templating, websockets and async.

Server-side rendering, bi-directional messaging, and handlers that never block.

  • Templating
  • Websockets
  • Async
library(ambiorix)

app <- Ambiorix$new(port = 3000L)

app$get("/:book", function(req, res) {
  res$render(
    "home.html",
    data = list(title = req$params$book)
  )
})

app$start()
<!-- templates/home.html -->
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <title>[% title %]</title>
</head>
<body>
  <h1>[% title %]</h1>
  <p>Welcome to Ambiorix!</p>
</body>
</html>
library(ambiorix)

app <- Ambiorix$new(port = 3000L)

app$get("/", function(req, res) {
  res$send_file("home.html")
})

# listen to incoming websocket messages
app$receive("hello", function(msg, ws) {
  print(msg)
  ws$send("hello", "Hello back! (sent from R)")
})

app$start()
library(ambiorix)
library(future)

plan(multisession)

now <- function() {
  format(
    x = Sys.time(),
    format = "%F %T",
    usetz = TRUE
  )
}

app <- Ambiorix$new(port = 3000L)

app$get("/slow", function(req, res) {
  future({
    Sys.sleep(10)
    res$send(now())
  })
})

app$get("/fast", function(req, res) {
  res$send(now())
})

app$start()
